To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a novel seq2 seq architecture is devised to efficiently process long dance motion sequences and capture fine-grained correspondence of dance and music; 2) a novel curriculum learning approach is proposed to alleviate error accumulation problem of autoregressive motion generation; 3) the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both automatic and human evaluations.

we propose a novel architecture for music-driven long-term dance generation and devise an effective curriculum learning strategy to improve the performance of autoregressive model on long sequence prediction.
